title: Short Term Rental Spreadsheet 2027, Host Income Expense Tracker, Occupancy ADR Dashboard, Cleaning Schedule, Pricing Calculator, Google Sheets
description:
Run your short term rental like a pro. Host Command Center is one spreadsheet that tracks your bookings, profit, occupancy, cleanings, supplies, pricing and year-end numbers, so you always know how your rental is really doing.

WORKS IN EXCEL AND GOOGLE SHEETS. Instant download.

10 TABS THAT WORK TOGETHER
1. Start: set your properties, booking platforms with their fee %, cleaners and expense categories once
2. Dashboard: gross revenue, net profit, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, nights booked, average rating, month-by-month table and charts. Filter by property or see your whole portfolio
3. Bookings: enter dates and rate; nights, platform fees and payouts calculate automatically
4. Expenses: dropdown categories, per property or shared
5. Cleaning: your turnover schedule builds itself from your bookings and flags same-day turnovers. Track cleaner pay
6. Inventory: set minimum levels; anything low turns red with a restock list and budget
7. Maintenance: log issues, priority, cost and status
8. Pricing: find your break-even and target nightly rate from your real costs, occupancy and profit goal, plus seasonal rates
9. Taxes: year-end income and expenses by category, per property, ready to share with your accountant
10. Reviews: track ratings and replies; your average shows on the dashboard

DETAILS
- Up to 10 properties and 500 bookings per year
- Comes filled with sample data so you can see how it works; clear the yellow rows and start
- Yellow cells are for you, white cells calculate automatically
- Any currency (change the cell format)

HOW TO USE IT IN GOOGLE SHEETS
Download the .xlsx file, open Google Drive, upload it, then open it with Google Sheets (File > Save as Google Sheets).

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL product. No physical item will be shipped.
- Excel 2019 / Microsoft 365 or Google Sheets recommended. Apple Numbers is not supported.
- The tax summary organizes your records and is not tax advice.
- For your own business use. Please do not resell or share the file.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and tested by me.

Questions or want a custom version for your properties? Send me a message, I usually reply within 24 hours.
